technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with recent hull/supertrend bullish flips are offset by price trading below all major moving averages, negative CMF, and weak trend strength—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: APO shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 84 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but no congressional conviction signal and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (431), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and recent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions for Financials sector despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip + supertrend bullish + extreme fear (13/100) contrarian signal + price near support (45.86) create technical setup for mean reversion bounce in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 431, rising dollar, high credit spreads), price below all major moving averages, negative CMF, weak ADX (29.44), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 84 days create hostile environment that overwhelms technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows hull/supertrend bullish flips at support with extreme oversold conditions (stoch 22.84, RSI 43.54) offering contrarian mean-reversion opportunity. Extreme fear (13/100) presents classic capitulation signal in Financials sector.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (VIX 431, rising dollar, high credit spreads) and price trading below all major moving averages create hostile backdrop that can overwhelm technical bounce; earnings in 84 days add uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show bullish signals but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents heavily weighted toward caution; macro environment dominates conviction.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 11 positions in Financials sector (7.1% of portfolio); adding APO increases concentration risk in adverse macro conditions and should be avoided until sector headwinds ease.
